name: write_data
title: Write Binary Data
description: Writes bytes to the currently selected data source at the specified address. The data source must be writable and the write must stay within the current size of the data source. Use this for binary patching.

address.description: Address to write to in the selected data source

data.description: Data to write, encoded according to the 'encoding' parameter

handle.description: Handle of the data source that was written to

address.description: Address the data was written to

bytes_written.description: Number of bytes that were written
